details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The predicted answer gives separate rates whose sum is 39.51%, not the gold target of 39.50%, so it does not provide the target rate accurately.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
1. Citation [3] identifies 2025 as the latest record and gives 8,174 submissions, 1,811 main-track acceptances, and 1,418 Findings acceptances.
2. Combining the main conference and Findings gives 1,811 + 1,418 = 3,229 acceptances. Dividing by 8,174 submissions gives 39.50% when rounded to two decimal places.
3. The citation therefore contains all non-trivial information needed to derive the gold target answer.
